summary: Built SC-016: migration 0005_feedback.sql (feedback and feedback_replies, STRICT, AUTOINCREMENT, 0004's FK clauses), the internal/feedback package (Send returns only an error, OwnerInbox, UTC-only times), POST /reports/{slug}/feedback on auth.Participant, the "Feedback for the author" box on the shared reader layout, and the owner's inbox on /admin/reports/{slug} beside the dislike count. The four fitness rules already in .taad/fitness.yaml (modified before this build, matching the design) were kept, and 59 fire/quiet corpus rows were added for them. The five accepted fixes (m1-m4, M-add-1) are built as decided. `go vet ./...` and `go test -count=1 ./...` pass, including the Chrome test. The planted E-005 finish test, built and run against the shipped binary, fails with exactly one failure, "the admin view offers no reply to the feedback" (SC-017's route). A signed-in headless Chrome look shows the reader box and the owner's inbox rendering, and the sent note hidden by default and revealed by #feedback-sent.

files.why: feedback and feedback_replies tables and their indexes; FK clauses copied from 0004, spike-measured; two-hop cascade
Book: New, Send (single INSERT...SELECT with the published check, returns only error), OwnerInbox, Message (no Replies), unixUTC, ErrBadBody == comments.ErrBadBody, ErrNoTarget
package tests: round trip, no id returned, published-only send, refused body runs no SQL, inbox order/scope, UTC with the zone forced off UTC
postFeedback in postComment's order; 303 to #feedback-sent on success and #feedback when signed out; never holds a row id
app.feedback field, built in New on st.DB() with the shared clock; POST /reports/{slug}/feedback registered next to the comment route
adminData.Feedback; adminReport reads OwnerInbox after the tally and answers 500 on a read error
feedback box: anonymous hint, owner link to the admin page, signed-in form plus hidden #feedback-sent note
includes the feedback template between #votes and #comments
feedback inbox section directly after the Votes tally: article id=feedback-N with avatar when set, login, UTC time, escaped body; empty-state line
widens the .comments section/textarea selectors to .feedback and .feedback-inbox, adds .feedback-message, .feedback-sent and the #feedback-sent:target reveal rule; neutral colours only

harness helpers and TestFeedbackSend, RefusedSenders, Bodies, HiddenReports (incl. trigger race), StoreFailure, DoesNotInterfere (other readers, sender, comment ids), FollowsReportLifecycle, Box, OwnerList
observe() gains a per-observer feedback POST that writes nothing, extending TestDislikesDoNotInterfere to the new route
TestReaderPathVariants gains the /feedback rows; TestReaderPagesShareOneLayout seeds a private message and asserts the box and that no page shows it
TestFeedbackMigrationFromPopulatedV4 (v4 rows intact, keys enforced, two-hop cascade, AUTOINCREMENT, newer-schema refusal) and TestFeedbackMigrationFromFreshVersions (1 to 4)
59 fire/quiet rows, 4 bounded_by entries and 4 rules_under_test entries for the four feedback fences
the four feedback rules were already in the tree uncommitted (marked 'settled by SL-007'); they match the design exactly and were kept unchanged

obligations.how: TestFeedbackSend feeds a signed-in non-owner's valid body: 303 to /reports/x#feedback-sent with empty body and no row id, one feedback row (report, sender, normalised body), zero comments rows, the second send answered byte-identically, and the owner's admin page showing article feedback-N with the text and the sender's login.

TestFeedbackRefusedSenders: no/expired/unknown/malformed session with normal, garbage, empty, no-form and 70 KiB bodies all get 303 to #feedback and store nothing; cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site and a foreign Origin with a live session get 403; same-origin controls are taken; the ghost text is absent from the admin view.

TestFeedbackBodies feeds every refused shape (empty, whitespace, 5001 runes, NUL, DEL, U+0085, invalid UTF-8, no field, two fields, query-string only, over 64 KiB, non-form content types) expecting 400 and no row, and every accepted shape (exactly 5000 runes, CRLF, lone CR, multi-line, <script>x</script>) checking the stored text; the admin page shows the markup escaped.

TestFeedbackHiddenReports: draft, unpublished, deleted and unknown slugs answer identical http.NotFound bytes for anonymous, reader and owner. The race is driven over HTTP with a test-only BEFORE INSERT trigger doing RAISE(IGNORE): 404 with NotFound bytes, equal to the unknown-slug answer for the same session, zero rows. TestSendNeedsPublishedReport covers Send to a draft id returning ErrNoTarget with zero rows.

TestFeedbackStoreFailure: DROP TABLE sessions gives 503 with no redirect for a live and for an unknown 43-character cookie, with nothing stored; renaming feedback gives 503 on the write while reader pages still draw; an unreadable inbox gives 500 on /admin/reports/x with no feedback markup and no empty-list text; a closed store gives 503.

TestFeedbackDoesNotInterfere 'other readers' feedback': readers 20 and 21 send on x and y while observe() (now with each observer's feedback POST) is byte-identical before and after; /admin/reports/x and /y change, one article per message with exactly its sender's login; the comment-ids subtest compares two worlds (feedback sent vs none) and the next comment's id and page. TestDislikesDoNotInterfere stays green with the extended observe().

TestFeedbackDoesNotInterfere/the sender's own pages are unchanged by a send: reader 20's / and /reports/x are byte-identical before and after its own send, and neither shows the message; the owner's admin page does show it. SC-017 replaces this one subtest.

TestFeedbackFollowsReportLifecycle with raw-inserted feedback_replies rows: Replace keeps the report id and all rows, unpublish gives 404 on the POST while the admin page still lists the messages, a second sign-in under a new login shows the new login with the count unchanged, Library.Delete returns nil leaving 0 feedback and 0 replies for that report with foreign_key_check empty, ids are not reused (AUTOINCREMENT), and a successor report under the slug starts empty.

TestFeedbackMigrationFromPopulatedV4 opens a populated user_version-4 database (users, reports, comment, vote) with the current binary: user_version == newestVersion, foreign_key_check empty, v4 rows intact, keys enforced, two-hop cascade; TestFeedbackMigrationFromFreshVersions does the same from fresh databases at versions 1 to 4.

TestReaderPathVariants gains nine /feedback rows mirroring the comment rows: GET/HEAD/PUT 405 Allow: POST, trailing slash and /extra 404, POST /reports/feedback 405 (page route), //reports/x/feedback and /reports/x/../y/feedback 307 cleanups, and an anonymous POST to a draft x equal to an unknown x.

TestFeedbackBox (anonymous hint and no textarea/form; non-owner form, hidden sent note, box between #votes and #comments and outside every comment article; owner admin link and no form; site.css reveal rule and neutral colours) and TestReaderPagesShareOneLayout (/ and /reports/newest identical for owner, non-owner and anonymous with a message sent). The found-state blank assay TestReportScriptsNeverRun ran Chrome and passed.

TestFeedbackOwnerList: empty report line; messages from two senders newest first, each article holding only its own login; avatar img only for the sender who has one; another report's messages absent; an unpublished report's feedback still listed; two dislikes cast with exactly the like and dislike counts beside labels; non-owner and anonymous refused; inbox between the tally and Preview; times asserted as the clock's UTC instant with time.Local forced to +5:30.

Read the finish body in place from the ledger (SELECT, mode=ro), patched ROOT to this worktree, ran it with python -I against a freshly built binary and a stand-in GitHub: exit 1, 'FAILED (failures=1)', and the one failure is 'the admin view offers no reply to the feedback'. Everything before the reply route (form, sends, anonymous refusal, privacy sweeps, feedback-N elements with logins, dislike count 2) passed. check_finish_one_failure.py reruns this and exits 0 only on that outcome; it lives in the scratch folder, not the repo.

feedback.Book.Send returns only error (INSERT...SELECT and RowsAffected 0 -> ErrNoTarget unchanged); postFeedback never holds an id, and its Location is built from the stored slug and a fixed fragment. TestSendReturnsNoID (fails to compile if Send grows a return value) and TestFeedbackSend (byte-identical 303s, exact Location) pin it. Tests and the admin markup read ids through SQL or OwnerInbox.
obligations.not_mutable: The fix is a function signature: putting an id back needs edits in two files (Send and the handler), which one replacement cannot express. It is pinned at compile time by TestSendReturnsNoID and by the exact-Location, byte-identical-answer assertions in TestFeedbackSend.

obligations.how: TestFeedbackHiddenReports drives the unpublished-between-lookup-and-write branch over HTTP with CREATE TRIGGER fb_skip BEFORE INSERT ON feedback ... RAISE(IGNORE): asserts 404 with http.NotFound bytes, sameResponse with the unknown-slug answer for the same session, zero rows added, then DROP TRIGGER and a control send. ErrNoTarget stays feedback's own sentinel, as decided.

One unexported unixUTC(s int64) time.Time in internal/feedback is the only conversion; OwnerInbox sets Message.When through it; the admin template uses datetime layout 2006-01-02T15:04:05Z. TestInboxTimesAreUTC and TestFeedbackOwnerList force time.Local to +5:30 so they are not blind on a UTC machine, assert When.Location()==time.UTC and Equal(sentAt), and compare the drawn text with h.clock.Now().UTC() formatted at send time (no literal timestamps).

SC-016's Message has no Replies field and there is no Reply type; SC-017 adds the type, the field and OwnerInbox's second SELECT together. The package compiles on its own and the cascade is pinned with SQL counts on raw reply rows.
obligations.not_mutable: The fix is the absence of a field and a type; there is nothing for a test to observe, and putting them back is not a single replacement in one file.

tests.note: Signed in via OAuth in Chrome each time (0.4-0.7 s). Reader page: box, form and hidden sent note in the DOM; screenshot shows 'Feedback for the author', the note line and the textarea, with no 'Sent to the author.' visible. With #feedback-sent in the next= path the note shows under the button, also at 492 px. Owner admin page: two articles newest first, avatar for the sender with one, escaped markup, a 120-character word wrapped, UTC times, inbox between the dislike count and Preview. Owner reader page shows the admin link and no form; anonymous shows the hint and no textarea. No hband or headless Chrome process left running.

deviations: O-016 (m1): Send returns only error, not (int64, error) as the design's Book surface says, so the public handler never holds a row id.
O-019 (m4): Message has no Replies field and there is no Reply type in SC-016; the design listed Replies on the SC-016 surface.

O-020 (M-add-1): a successful send answers 303 to #feedback-sent (design choice 5 was #feedback for both). The signed-in non-owner box always draws a hidden 'Sent to the author.' note that site.css reveals only on :target. The signed-out answer stays #feedback. Accepted cost: a stale 'Sent' on a bookmarked post-send URL.

O-018 (m3): all created_at scans go through one unexported unixUTC helper. The UTC tests force time.Local to +5:30 instead of comparing against the clock's own zone, so they are not blind on a UTC machine.
The finish-line check (C-013) is a scratch script, not a committed test: the planted finish body lives only in the ledger and is read in place with a read-only SELECT. The script is not in the repo.
No outside defect is worked around by this slice, so no workaround setting or notice was added.
The design judged a real-browser look not material. One was done anyway, using the spike's measured recipe, and found nothing to fix.
not_built: The reply route (adminRoutes row POST /admin/feedback/{n}/reply), feedback.Reply, OwnerReplyTarget, OwnerReply, Sent, SenderThreads, readerData.OwnFeedback and the sender's own-thread list: SC-017, as the design says. The E-005 finish test stays red on exactly that.
Marking feedback from blocked accounts as 'blocked': SC-021. OwnerInbox has no blocked_accounts join yet and Message has no Blocked field.

A real-browser click on the feedback form's submit button (CSP form-action 'self', SameSite=Lax cookie, real Sec-Fetch-Site on a same-site POST). Chrome rendered the signed-in pages and followed the #feedback-sent fragment, but the POST was sent by a Python client with same-origin headers. This is open question Q-014 for votes and applies equally here.

No screens or app were declared. The engine cannot start this app with a bare command: internal/config refuses to start without HBAND_OWNER_GITHUB_ID, HBAND_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and HBAND_BASE_URL (lesson #961), and `app.command` allows no environment. The signed-in pages were looked at in Chrome by hand-built harness instead.
follow_ups: SC-017: build the reply route, SenderThreads and the sender's own-thread list from the design, and replace the sender subtest of TestFeedbackDoesNotInterfere with 'shows exactly its own thread'; add the adminRoutes row so it joins TestAdminAccessMatrix.
SC-021: add the blocked_accounts EXISTS to OwnerInbox and a Blocked flag to feedback.Message; the C-009 architecture line already promises 'blocked accounts marked', which is untrue until then.
Deferred m5: the owner's inbox is unbounded and sits above Preview/Publish/Replace/Delete. Duplicates from readers who do not see the note are possible, and no rate limit exists until E-006.
Q-014: drive a real click on a signed-in form submit (vote, comment and feedback) in headless Chrome, which needs a committed signed-in harness (the scratch browser_look.py recipe could be promoted).
Lesson #954 still applies: SC-016 is not releasable alone, since a sender sees only a transient 'Sent' note and no thread until SC-017 ships.

architecture.why: New files of this slice: internal/feedback/feedback.go, migration 0005_feedback.sql, server/feedback.go (postFeedback), templates/feedback.html and their tests; no block's globs name them (C-007 has no owns list).
internal/feedback/feedback.go imports internal/comments for Normalize and ErrBadBody, so feedback and comments share one set of plain-text rules (feedback.ErrBadBody == comments.ErrBadBody).

architecture.find: and the author's private replies to them. Each feedback thread is visible only to its reader and the owner. Feedback from blocked accounts is kept and marked as blocked.
architecture.replace: stored in feedback and feedback_replies, which only internal/feedback names in SQL. Today the only reader is the owner's admin page (OwnerInbox, newest first, with each sender's current login and avatar). A message is never drawn on a reader page; the sender is told only by a hidden 'Sent to the author.' note that the #feedback-sent fragment of the post-send 303 reveals. No reply is written or shown yet, and feedback from blocked accounts is stored but not marked.
architecture.why: internal/feedback/feedback.go (Send, OwnerInbox; no reply or SenderThreads code), internal/server/feedback.go (303 to #feedback-sent), templates/feedback.html (hidden #feedback-sent note), admin.go adminReport (OwnerInbox); migration 0005 creates feedback_replies but nothing writes it.
